k:傾.mnemonic: The leader (亻) is about (頃) to fall asleep in the meeting. Slowly, he tilts over to one side. Lean (incline, tilt, trend).

k:誉.mnemonic: What people say (言) about you is so good that your name seems to have a sparkle (⺌) above it. Reputation (praise, honor, glory).
k:誉.hint: A name with a shine on it.

k:舗.mnemonic: The task (用): lay ten (十) flat stones from the road to the door of the cottage (舎), so that customers reach the shop with clean shoes. Pave (shop, store).
k:舗.hint: Ten flat stones to the door.

k:簡.mnemonic: A note on a strip of bamboo (竹) hung on the gate (門). It gives the day (日) and not one word more. Simplicity (brevity).
k:簡.hint: One word on a bamboo strip.

k:浴.mnemonic: Hot water pours like a tsunami (氵) into the valley (谷) and fills a steaming pool. Step in up to your neck. Bathe (be favored with, bask in).

k:飾.mnemonic: Before the guests eat (食), spread the linen (布) cloth and arrange the table until it looks too pretty to touch. Decorate (ornament, adorn, embellish).

k:腰.mnemonic: After a month (月) of heavy lifting, what you need (要) most is a rest for the middle of your body, the part that bends. Loins (hips, waist).
k:腰.hint: Where a month of lifting hurts.

k:譲.mnemonic: Six (六) people at one doorway, each tugging at another's garment (衣) to say (言) 'no, after you'. Nobody will go first. Defer (turnover, transfer, convey).

k:寿.mnemonic: Three (三) lifetimes by any normal measurement (寸): the old man has outlived everyone he ever knew. Longevity (congratulations, one's natural life).

k:肩.mnemonic: The door (戸) has been stuck for a month (月). You give up pushing with your hands and ram it with the top of your arm. Shoulder.

k:菜.mnemonic: Neither flowers (艹) nor a tree (木) but the leafy thing in between, which a hand like a claw (爪) plucks for the pot. Vegetable (side dish, greens).
k:菜.hint: Leafy thing plucked for the pot.

k:渋.mnemonic: Bite an unripe persimmon. The tsunami (氵) of saliva comes to a stop (止) and your mouth puckers as if it were full of icicles (冫). Astringent (hesitate, reluctant).

k:殊.mnemonic: Of all the stocks (株) on the market, the one in dinosaur bones (歹) stands apart from the rest. The broker circles it twice. Particularly (especially, exceptionally, special).

k:陰.mnemonic: They meet (会) on the side of the mound (阝) that the sun never reaches, where it is cool and nobody can see them. Shade (yin, negative, secret).

k:遂.mnemonic: The pig (豕) sets off down the path (辶) and does not stop until it has reached the very end. Job done. Consummate (accomplish, attain).
k:遂.hint: Pig that reaches the path's end.

k:圏.mnemonic: A person (人) unrolls a scroll (巻) map and draws a fence (囗) around all the ground he can cover in a day. Range (sphere, circle, radius).

k:威.mnemonic: Under the overhang (厂) of the palace roof, a woman (女) has become (成) empress. One look from her and generals step back. Intimidate (dignity, majesty, menace).

k:浪.mnemonic: A stubborn (艮) wave left over from the tsunami (氵) will not settle on any shore, and rolls on from coast to coast. Wandering (waves, billows, reckless).

k:距.mnemonic: With one swing of a gigantic (巨) leg (足), the giant steps from this town to the next. Long-distance (spur, fetlock).

k:析.mnemonic: An axe (斤) comes down on a tree (木), and the log falls into pieces small enough to study one by one. Chop (divide, tear, analyze).
k:析.hint: Log split into pieces to study.

k:銭.mnemonic: A halberd (戈) shaves a thin round slice off a bar of gold (金). That slice is your small change. Coin (money, gold, metal).
k:銭.hint: Thin slice off a gold bar.

k:黙.mnemonic: A black (黒) dog (犬) on a black night. It sits by the door and does not bark once. Silence (become silent, stop speaking).

k:輝.mnemonic: A ray (光) of morning sun strikes the polished armour of a whole army (軍), and the hillside flashes like a field of stars. Radiance (shine, sparkle, gleam).
k:輝.hint: Sun flashing off an army's armour.

k:柱.mnemonic: The master (主) tree (木) of the house: the one thick trunk in the centre that holds up the whole roof. Pillar (post, cylinder, support).
k:柱.hint: The trunk holding the roof up.

k:炭.mnemonic: Under an overhang (厂) on the mountain (山), wood is baked in a slow fire (火) until it turns black and light. Charcoal (coal).
k:炭.hint: Wood baked black on the mountain.

k:騒.mnemonic: An insect (虫) stings the horse (馬), which kicks the stable wall, and every other horse also (又) joins in. What a racket. Boisterous (make noise, clamor, disturb).
k:騒.hint: Stung horse sets off the stable.

k:抑.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) press the stamp (卩) down hard and hold it there, so that nothing underneath can move. Repress (push).

k:潮.mnemonic: Not a tsunami (氵) but the sea that climbs the beach every morning (朝) and goes out again, always on time. Tide (salt water, opportunity).
k:潮.hint: The sea that keeps its timetable.

k:奉.mnemonic: A person (人) lifts an offering in both hands toward heaven (天), as the rite requires on this day every year. Observance (offer, present, dedicate).

k:銅.mnemonic: When new it shines the same (同) as gold (金), but it is the cheap reddish metal of pots and small change. Copper.
